results.title: Browse tour packages
results.steps: Open home and inspect tour cards.
results.expected: Tour A, Tour B and Tour C are visible.
results.actual: Home page displayed three tour cards.

results.title: Sign-in prompt before booking
results.steps: Click Tour A while logged out.
results.actual: Clicking Tour A opened the sign-in modal.

results.title: Simulated account creation
results.steps: Switch to signup, enter QA name/email/password, submit.
results.actual: Simulated signup opened the booking form.

results.title: Calculate booking total
results.steps: Set two guests and enable both add-ons.
results.actual: Two guests plus ETDF and lagoon add-ons displayed PHP 3,900.

results.title: Simulated checkout payment
results.steps: Fill normal-format card details and click Pay.
results.expected: Processing and success notifications, then dashboard.
results.actual: Simulated processing redirected to dashboard. No real payment was attempted.

results.title: Display booking and invoice
results.expected: Confirmed status, reference, guest details and itinerary appear.
results.actual: Dashboard displays confirmed status, reference and sample invoice details; this legacy case checks presence only.

results.title: PDF contents match displayed invoice
results.steps: Open downloaded PDF and compare fields.
results.expected: PDF contents match the on-screen invoice.
results.actual: TC-008R produced no PDF, so content comparison could not execute.

results.title: Booking details reach checkout
results.steps: Compare checkout with the preceding two-guest booking.
results.expected: Guest count, date and contact match entered data.
results.actual: Checkout shows 1 Pax and Pending Confirmation; entered 2 guests, 2026-09-27, +639123456789. Contact is absent.

results.title: Checkout total preserves add-ons
results.steps: Compare checkout total against PHP 3,900 booking.
results.actual: Checkout and Pay button show PHP 1,350, while booked total was PHP 3,900.

results.title: Dashboard matches actual booking
results.expected: Name, contact, guest count, date and total match.
results.actual: Dashboard shows Juan Dela Cruz, 1 Guest, Pending Confirmation and PHP 1,350 instead of the QA booking.

results.title: Reject empty card fields
results.steps: Open checkout and click Pay with all card fields empty.
results.expected: Stay on checkout with required-field validation.
results.actual: Browser rejected submission: four required fields invalid; stayed on checkout.

results.title: Reject invalid card formats
results.steps: Separately test card=abc, expiry=99/99, and CVC=abc, with remaining fields valid.
results.actual: Simulated payment accepted malformed card number, expiry, CVC and navigated to dashboard.

results.title: Reject a past tour date
results.steps: Open booking with Dev Status logged in, enter date ten days ago, submit.
results.actual: Booking accepted past date 2026-09-07 and navigated to checkout.

results.title: Admin route smoke tests
results.steps: Open admin overview, quotation, clients, products and invoices.
results.expected: Each returns HTTP 200, has visible content and no page runtime error.
results.actual: All five admin routes returned HTTP 200 and rendered content. /admin/quotation raised React #418 hydration error. Other four routes produced no page runtime error.

results.title: Submit admin quotation and display record
results.steps: Enter a unique client and look for quotation submission/record creation.
results.expected: Quotation submission creates an identifiable record.
results.actual: No quotation submit/save control exists. Page provides a live preview, simulated PDF and send actions, but no record creation. Requirement inferred from original deck; confirm agreed scope.

results.title: Clean Windows dependency installation
results.steps: From no node_modules, run npm ci --no-audit --no-fund.
results.expected: Install succeeds without force or source changes.
results.actual: npm ci exited 1 with EBADPLATFORM for @tailwindcss/oxide-linux-x64-gnu@4.3.3. npm ci --force was required to continue QA.
